summary: Intuitive Machines filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $500 million of Class A common stock. The company will sell shares through agents including Barclays and Cantor Fitzgerald, with compensation of up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. Sales occur at prevailing market prices on Nasdaq, with no escrow or trust arrangement. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 415(a)(4) to raise capital, not a special situation. No control premium, board recommendation, or structural complexity is present.
